component.name: Calen
component.summary: A fast calendar that lives in your tray

description.p: Calen is a fast, native calendar with no web view. It lives in the system tray, syncs with CalDAV servers such as Nextcloud and Radicale, and works offline.

ul.li: Day, week and month views: drag to move, resize and create events
Quick add from one line of text, such as “Lunch with Sam tomorrow 12:30 /work !15m”
A command palette to search events and change settings
Reminders with Join and Snooze, held back during Do Not Disturb and games
Offline-first CalDAV sync that keeps both versions when an event conflicts
Join buttons for Zoom, Meet and Teams links, and map links for places
Optional photos on events, stored on a host you choose

description.p: On GNOME, the tray icon needs the AppIndicator extension. Without it, Calen keeps running in the background and shows a notification with Open and Quit.
